title: Quality and Testing
description: Unit, integration, end-to-end, pytest, fixtures, mocking, test doubles, TDD, CI, coverage, and regression testing.

lessons.title: Testing Levels
lessons.summary: Unit tests isolate small logic; integration tests verify boundaries; end-to-end tests exercise workflows.
lessons.explanation: Unit tests isolate small logic; integration tests verify boundaries; end-to-end tests exercise workflows. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: A progress formula can be unit-tested without an HTTP server.
interview_questions: When would you apply testing levels?
What failure mode appears when testing levels is misunderstood?

lessons.title: Pytest and Fixtures
lessons.summary: Fixtures provide reusable setup and teardown for tests.
lessons.explanation: Fixtures provide reusable setup and teardown for tests. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: A temporary SQLite database fixture keeps tests isolated.

lessons.title: Mocks, Coverage, and Regression
lessons.summary: Mocks replace slow boundaries; coverage highlights untested code; regression tests preserve fixed bugs.
lessons.explanation: Mocks replace slow boundaries; coverage highlights untested code; regression tests preserve fixed bugs. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: Mock an email sender but test the request validation for real.

lessons.title: CI and Quality Gates
lessons.summary: CI runs tests automatically so broken changes are caught before merging.
lessons.explanation: CI runs tests automatically so broken changes are caught before merging. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: A pull request should run backend and frontend tests.

coding_challenges.title: Quality and Testing status classifier
coding_challenges.instructions: Implement classify_status_code(code: int) -> str. Return success for 200-299, redirect for 300-399, client_error for 400-499, server_error for 500-599, and unknown otherwise.
coding_challenges.explanation: The challenge reinforces deterministic branching, status-code categories, and local test execution.
